newsitem.title: USA: Successories says stake changes hands.
newsitem.headline: Successories says stake changes hands.

text.p: Successories Inc said Thursday that partnerships have sold their entire stake in the company, the equivalent of about one million common shares, to institutional and individual investors, members of Successories' senior management, and the company.
Successories repurchased the equivalent of 91,500 common shares of convertible preferred stock from the partnerships.
The partnerships had acquired the shares from the company in a private placement of convertible preferred stock in December of 1996.
The preferred shares were converted into common stock prior to their sale to the individual investors. The shares purchased by the company were not converted into common stock.

"We expect this transaction to eliminate the perceived overhang of shares held by these large institutional investors with a shorter term investment horizon than we had expected," said James Beltrame, president and chief executive officer, in a news release.
Successories sells products for business and personal motivation through stores and mail order catalogs.
